tools.name: health
tools.description: Health check for Wedding Gift Board. Returns ok, storage, paapi, tagConfigured, linkMode, catalogCount (amazon.se) / catalogCounts (amazon.se + amazon.com), marketplaces.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts. Pick the user's marketplace and pass it on search/resolve/create (amazon.com for US, en-US). Curated catalogs: amazon.se and amazon.com.

tools.name: browse_catalog
tools.description: Curated, live-verified wedding gift products for a storefront: amazon.se (Sweden) or amazon.com (United States). Each item has a /dp buyUrl, price and image. Optional q / occasion / budgetBand / styleTag filters.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search Amazon for wedding / registry gifts on the user's marketplace. Pass marketplace + locale (amazon.com + en for United States users; amazon.se + sv for Sweden). Both optional — omitted means en-US Accept-Language → amazon.com, else amazon.se.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a couple wedding gift board. Returns id, editToken, coupleUrl, guestUrl. Pass marketplace (amazon.com for US users, amazon.se for Sweden) + locale; optional, defaults as described.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated wedding gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. One-shot: create a wedding gift board and fill from ASINs/keywords/queries. Pass marketplace (amazon.com for US users, amazon.se for Sweden) + locale; optional, defaults as described.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to a wedding gift board. Requires editToken from create.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon /dp URL, or keywords to a marketplace URL. Pass marketplace + locale (amazon.com + en for United States users; amazon.se + sv for Sweden). Both optional — omitted means en-US Accept-Language → amazon.com, else amazon.se.
